scope: independent root audit of the conditional actual-beta mesoscopic incidence tower, first-hit factorization, all-layer height, and squarefull-de-overlapped low-incidence criterion

mathematical_audit.conditional_actual_scope: assuming an actual Item316 target, every active mesoscopic row carrier is one t-avoiding prime A<p<A^2; exact-zero and inactive rows contribute one
mathematical_audit.tower: a prime of row multiplicity nu_p occurs in exactly binom(nu_p,r) r-wise gcds, giving G_r and its radical R_r exactly
mathematical_audit.layer_cake: the identity product_j C_j=product_r R_r and the first-hit identity product_j D_j^(>A)=R_1 hold prime by prime
mathematical_audit.height: R_r^r divides the row product, so log R_r<2N_A log A/r; at r=2 this still permits one full log b scale
mathematical_audit.criterion: R_1=S_(<L)R_L makes a growing low-incidence bound necessary and sufficient for mesoscopic zero rate after Item346's small-prime theorem
mathematical_audit.squarefull_overlap: the v_p(Q)>=2 radical divides E(Q), while row incidence nu_p and denominator valuation v_p(Q) are distinct statistics
mathematical_audit.item350_scope: only selected-hit compatibility from Item350 is used; no genuine first-occurrence construction is imported
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the theorem isolates rather than proves the needed actual low-incidence squarefree bound and supplies no reduction of beta capacity
